# Avenxa

> Avenxa is a premium AI assistant for study, work, and everyday life — built by Avenxa Technology.

Avenxa supports text, images, files, and voice input, renders advanced mathematics with LaTeX, and remembers useful context across conversations. Guest mode lets anyone try it without an account.

## Pages

- [Avenxa home](/): Product entry point for the Avenxa AI assistant.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in with Google or email, or continue as a guest.
- [Guest mode](/guest): Try Avenxa without an account, with conversations stored locally.
